en: The image depicts an old, colorized scene of ancient stone walls with several towers in ruins. In the foreground, a large flock of sheep is being herded along a dirt path, suggesting a rural or pastoral setting near historic ruins. The sky is tinged with sunset colors. At the top, there is text in French: 'Constantinople. Les murs des 7 tours.' There is also a watermark reading 'www.elia.org.gr' at the bottom right.
